unanswered.name: Marco Galvan Duque (MarcoGalvanD)
unanswered.text: Terrible experience. The service at the bar was indifferent - the bartender acted as though he were doing me a favor by serving me. The food is far too expensive for the quality and presentation. I ordered a grilled chicken wedge salad and received, quite literally, a huge chunk of iceberg lettuce.

I'd like to make it right if you'll give us another shot. - Joal, Owner

unanswered.name: Andy Watts
unanswered.text: We had fish and chips, oh my days, stunnning. And great service too. Best fish and chips Ive experienced.
unanswered.draftReply: Andy, best fish and chips you've had is a hell of a thing to hear -- our cooks will be insufferable now. Thanks for calling out the service too. Come back hungry. -- Joal, The Brewhouse

unanswered.name: Greg Quinn
unanswered.text: The Brewhouse has amazing, fresh food menu selections at very reasonable prices and the adult beverages hit the spot. I am a pilsner/lager guy and the one I had was so good I ordered one more. I thought the nachos were on point and the Schnitzel comes with 3 sauce options that are gourmet. Fresh seafood will be my go to next time. The staff is awesome and I even got to meet one of the owners who informed me The Brewhouse is the longest-running bar in SB, and soon they'll be able to craft their own spirits!
unanswered.draftReply: Greg, a pilsner guy going back for a second round is the highest praise a brewery can get. Glad the nachos and the schnitzel sauces hit the mark too, and thanks for the kind words about the crew. Come back for the seafood and we'll pour you a cold one. -- Joal, The Brewhouse

unanswered.name: M

The everything bagel was exceptional, perfectly toasted to light crunch on the outside with a soft an chewy interior and a generous topping of melting butter alongside a prodigal portion of cream cheese. unanswered.draftReply: Luke, that may be the most thorough bagel review we have ever received and we are keeping it. Glad the burrito ratio landed right too. Come back hungry.
